status: Source-exposed follow-up, fixed after L51 analysis and before new counterpart counts
purpose: Authenticate the ending association in original catalogues and delimit an optional-sign interpretation without assigning meanings
source_exclusion: Remove named L51/M636 from comparison universe, then repeat existing site/type/length conditioned calculation. This is retrospective leave-example-out, not independent held-out data or a new significance test.
exact_counterpart: For every eligible complete single-row strict seal beginning W527 W555, remove exactly its second token W555. Find identical entire remaining sequences in the same universe. Preserve site/type and complete original sequences. No allograph or semantic equality assumed.
alternate_endings: Describe complete eligible sequences with W555 as second file token but a different first token; position is file order, not a deciphered grammatical category.
physical_review: Check L51 prior review, M81/L89 new local CISI review, and attempt H459/M940/M1693/M1081/M1320/M1351 originals. Missing primary sources remain unverified, not negative observations.
limits: Catalogue photos authenticate surviving graphic structure, not meanings
A removable sign in parallel texts need not be an optional grammatical marker
Cross-site same-string counterparts do not establish same denotation
Named-source exclusion does not remove wider hypothesis selection or publication bias
